name: SDK Guide
author: ResonantOS
description: An interactive 9-step tutorial that teaches the @resonantos/addon-sdk by using it on this same loopback origin. Walks through every Phase-3 (P6) host-policy boundary: discovery, manifest validation, capability request, host consent, grant, sandboxed UI render, an authorized call (real 200), a denied call (real 401 — wrong bearer), and a revoked call (real 403 — host withdrew the grant). No step is hard-coded: every denial is a real host-policy result.

surfaces.label: SDK Guide
surfaces.description: Walk the full P6 lifecycle on a single add-on. The UI calls its own loopback upstream at each step; the upstream enforces every host-policy boundary symmetrically with Echo and Counter. Host revocation flips a real flag; the same bearer that succeeded moments earlier then returns 403.

grantPresets.label: Local SDK guide
grantPresets.description: Grant the local SDK guide upstream the host-minted bearer so the 9 steps can complete.
